card.name: Punctuation after list items
card.fires_on: Commas, spaces and small linking words that come right after an item in a list or a clause. Often seen in lists of conditions such as heart disease, heart attacks, strokes, dementia, and in citation lists.

modes.label: Comma inside a list
modes.description: A comma after a listed condition or phrase, just before the next item.
modes.example: Progestins with estrogens should not be used to prevent heart disease, heart attacks<<,>> strokes, or dementia.

modes.label: Space in citation lists
modes.description: The space after a comma between section numbers in a bracketed reference.
modes.example: or dementia [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1 , 5.3) , and Clinical Studies (14.3 ,<< >>14.4) ] .

modes.label: Linking word or sentence break
modes.description: A question mark, a word like "and", or a slash that joins or starts the next phrase.
modes.example: resulted in decreased OS<< and>> increased incidence of NCI-CTC

card.plain: It fires on commas and small joining marks that sit between items in a list, where another item is expected next.
